            - Section 152(d)(2)(H): An individual (other than spouse) who for the taxable year has the same principal place of abode as the taxpayer and is a member of the taxpayer's household.

            - However, look at Section 2(b)(3)(B): "a taxpayer shall not be considered to be a head of a household ... by reason of an individual who would not be a dependent for the taxable year but for subparagraph (H) of section 152(d)(2)."

            - Therefore, a friend (who is not related) **cannot** be the qualifying person to establish Head of Household status.
            - So Bob cannot be Head of Household because Charlie is only eligible as a dependent under (H), which is excluded for Head of Household status.
        - Bob is **not** Head of Household.
    - Section 2(a) Surviving Spouse conditions again:
        - (1) (A) Spouse died during either of the two years immediately preceding the taxable year. 2018's preceding two years are 2017 and 2016. Alice died in 2014. This condition fails.
